rawRetro.task: Issue #507 — Project materials (资料) with private attachments (私有附件)
decisions: Did not use @nocobase/app-plugin-file's public byte route: it is unauthenticated by design and would expose private documents. Implemented an app-owned authenticated content route instead.

Upload uses the stock clientFileRepositoryManagerToken contract (POST /api/projectMaterialFiles:uploadOne) so the app page works without touching the plugin; the route is app-owned and policy-scoped with defaults.ownerId = session user.
Page uses authz: 'skip' and the endpoints enforce authentication/authorization independently, because page authz is browser-only.
Removal is unlink-on-save (materialId = null, removeOnDelete: false); no recycle bin and no hard-delete.
Fixture bytes are embedded as base64 in a provider (seeds/migrations cannot resolve the drive service) and provisioned idempotently from a provider start().

DOCX hang remedy is a bounded load with one retry on a fresh viewer/Worker plus workerTimeoutMs, not a timeout-only fallback. A hover reload of the stuck page proves a fresh Worker recovers, and a timeout-only fallback would have turned a transient stall into a permanent error.

blockers.title: Seed importing a server module with a relative .js specifier failed ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND

blockers.resolution: Made the seed self-contained (only bare package specifiers).

blockers.title: Provider start() threw COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND under embedded-scope test hosts
blockers.symptom: Demo attachment provisioning failed when the host had no migrations.
blockers.rootCause: Those hosts run against a temp app root with no database/main/migrations, so the collection is never created.
blockers.resolution: provisionDemoAttachmentBytes reads the collection first and returns early when it is absent.

blockers.title: Corrupted images fell back silently to the filename, reading as preview success
blockers.symptom: A corrupted PNG showed only its filename with no explanation.
blockers.rootCause: The image preview had no load-error handling.
blockers.resolution: FileThumbnail and ImagePreview use a failedUrl derived-state pattern to render an explanatory fallback; the preview fallback is wrapped in role='alert' so it is assertable.

blockers.title: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect blocked synchronous failure state in an effect
blockers.symptom: Setting the failure state directly in an effect was an ESLint error.
blockers.rootCause: The react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rule treats synchronous setState in effects as an error.
blockers.resolution: Used a derived failedUrl comparison instead of effect-driven state, and set load state inside promise callbacks.

blockers.title: DOCX preview stayed on "Loading preview..." forever with an empty container
blockers.symptom: QA reported the DOCX preview dialog hanging on "Loading preview..." for >15s for both a freshly uploaded sample.docx and the seeded site-document.docx. Live DOM showed the [data-office-open-xml-format="docx"] host present, role=status "Loading preview...", zero canvases, no alert, and an inner sizer of width:1px; height:0px. A hard reload of the same URL rendered fine, and page.workers() was 0 in the stuck state.
blockers.rootCause: @silurus/ooxml always parses in a Worker (new Worker from an inline blob), even in mode:'main'. Its parse watchdog is armed only when the workerTimeoutMs option is supplied: _rearmParseWatchdog() starts a timer only if this._parseWatchdogMs !== undefined. The parse request is posted with timeoutMs: false (no request timeout) and _parseProgressively awaits firstPublication.promise, which resolves only on a layoutPartial push. With no workerTimeoutMs, a Worker that dies or stalls silently produces no progress and no error; load() never settles and onError never fires, so the dialog spins forever. The library's own watchdog would terminate the worker and reject with "worker layout produced no progress".
blockers.resolution: In office-open-xml-preview.tsx, pass workerTimeoutMs: 10000 so the library's progress-based watchdog arms and rejects load() after 10s of silence, retry once with a fresh viewer/Worker, and bound each load with a last-resort `withTimeout(..., 60_000)` so no viewer can ever leave the dialog spinning. Each attempt gets its own data.slice(0) because load() transfers/detaches the buffer. A per-attempt token keeps a late onError from a replaced viewer from condemning the replacement. The t translation is kept out of the effect deps via a ref so a re-render cannot restart the fetch or worker. The final failure renders the localized fallback alert rather than a silent filename. The watchdog is progress-based (re-armed on every layout push), so a large document that keeps making progress is not cut off.
blockers.cost: Long: required byte-level source analysis of the minified bundle (canvas-viewer-mechanics and bounded-raw-part-cache chunks) plus a live reproduction of the stall by stubbing the parser Worker, after ruling out the wasm fetch, service workers, background throttling, document.fonts.ready, and connection-pool exhaustion.

improvements.title: Reproduce a silent-worker stall by stubbing Worker, not by network blocking
improvements.detail: Blocking the wasm chunk or the async viewer chunk yields role=alert through onError, which never exercised the hang. Stubbing only blob: Worker constructions leaves the fetch healthy and the parser silent, reproducing the exact QA symptom on the pre-fix build. Playwright's addInitScript is enough.
improvements.suggestedChange: Keep a small browser repro that stubs blob Workers for OOXML preview regressions.

improvements.title: Bound third-party viewer loads and retry once on a fresh instance
improvements.detail: A viewer whose background Worker dies silently has no error channel. Telling the library to watch for silence (workerTimeoutMs) plus one retry on a fresh viewer/Worker converts a transient stall into a recovery and a real failure into an explanation within about 20s. A last-resort bound guards against a viewer that never settles at all. Retrying beats a timeout-only fallback because a hover reload of the stuck page recovers.
improvements.suggestedChange: When integrating a worker-backed viewer, always pass its watchdog option and wrap load() in a bounded retry.

modules.scope: 审查 @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 的会话中间件与 @nocobase/app-server 的路由贡献契约及其技能指引，聚焦未登录/越权拒绝与所有者可读。
modules.limitations: 未运行应用；对 401/记录级 404 的最终行为依据中间件源码、路由契约与验收报告。

requirements.need: 未登录访问者与普通同事乙均不能读取甲的资料或附件内容，甲可正常查看
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供会话解析中间件与类型化路由贡献契约；应用负责在每条路由应用 required() 并做记录级范围判断。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 defineApiRoutes 产出的 Hono 路由上挂 auth.required()，从 context.get('auth').user 取身份并据此过滤记录。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用正是这样装配：required 中间件、userIdOf、按 ownerId/createdById 过滤，B05 通过（乙/匿名被拒，甲可见）。

requirements.need: 写操作具备跨站请求防护，会话以同源 cookie 承载
requirements.responsibility: 框架在 required() 内做 cookie 写来源校验并提供会话读取。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用会话 cookie，写请求需匹配允许来源；本地/自定义域名需正确配置公开来源。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用使用 required()，其行为包含来源校验；验收在正确配置来源后通过。

requirementFit.reason: required() 直接产出 401 且把会话注入 context，配合定义路由贡献即可满足匿名与越权拒绝；应用与验收结果一致。

usability.reason: 中间件语义单一明确，AuthEnv 类型使路由可直接读取 auth；错误码稳定便于测试。

agentFriendliness.reason: auth 与 app-server 契约类型齐全、技能给出入口清单；但 cookie 写来源校验的环境配置需要额外理解。

design.reason: 认证中间件与路由贡献解耦，scope=api/root 分层清楚，应用只组合不修改插件源码。

reliability.reason: required() 覆盖来源校验、会话解析、401 分支与 context 注入，是稳定的保护原语。

modules.name: M4 迁移/仓储/事务与 Drive 存储
modules.scope: 审查 @nocobase/db 的迁移、builder、repository 与 transaction，以及 @nocobase/drive 的存储管理器与磁盘流，配套 nocobase-db 技能。
modules.limitations: 未运行迁移或访问磁盘；对 schema、过滤与流式读取的正确性以声明、实现与验收结果对照判断。

requirements.need: 资料与附件元数据（含所有权列）以迁移声明并一致地读写，失败保存不留下悬挂关联
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineMigration/builder 声明结构、Repository/Query 读写与事务；应用定义表、字段、索引与业务规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 迁移中用 builder 声明 collection 与索引，运行时用 database.repository 并以事务包裹多步写入；seed 用 upsertOne 保持幂等。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移按此声明两表与 ownerId/materialId 索引，运行时按 ownerId 过滤并以 database.transaction 包裹资料写入；B03/B04 通过。

requirements.need: 附件字节写入 Drive，移除附件只解除关联而不做物理销毁
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 Drive 管理器与磁盘流式读取；应用决定关联与清理策略。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 databaseManagerToken + driveManagerToken 的 use(disk).getStream 读取字节；元数据删除保留对象，由应用处理孤儿清理。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 openAttachment 用 drive.use(file.disk).exists/getStream 读取，移除附件时仅清除 materialId 关联；B04 通过。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移/仓储/事务与 Drive 流读取覆盖了持久化、所有权过滤与关联解除的全部需求，应用实现与 B01/B03/B04 结果一致。

usability.reason: repository 与 query 的取舍规则、连接名省略、事务只使用回调连接等约定清晰且有示例。

agentFriendliness.reason: DB 技能给出迁移/仓储/事务的边界与常见错误（空范围拒绝、关系写限制），但 seed 加载与模块解析仍可能在运行时才暴露问题。

design.reason: 迁移上下文与运行时 manager 的职责分离、事务连接语义、Drive 按磁盘隔离，整体分层清晰。

reliability.reason: transaction(fn) 语义明确（返回提交/抛错回滚），Repository 对空范围与关系写有保护，Drive 磁盘存在性检查可防悬挂读取。

findings.title: 文件插件把上传、元数据与存储职责清晰分层，应用无需重写存储即可复用
findings.detail: defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 以 policy+principal 统一约束上传与 CRUD，ServerFileRepositoryManager 提供 repository/uploadOne/getUrl，客户端 manager 与之契约一致；@nocobase/drive 负责磁盘与流。
findings.impact: 应用只需声明 collection 与业务关联即可获得一致的上传、元数据与读取原语，验证轮次中 B01/B03/B04 均通过。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该分层，并把“受限文件如何组合应用自有鉴权”做成可复制的最小示例，降低误判为“插件无上传路由”的概率。

findings.title: 注册表 OOXML 预览无超时/看门狗，解析 Worker 静默挂起时永久停留 Loading preview
findings.detail: office-open-xml-preview.tsx 在 effect 中直接 `await viewer.load(data)` 后再 setLoaded；createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 只传 mode/useGoogleFonts/onError，没有 workerTimeoutMs 等看门狗。@silurus/ooxml 默认在 Worker 中解析，若 Worker 静默死亡，load() 的 promise 不 settle，onError 也不会触发，于是预览既无正文也无失败提示。第一轮验收 B02 因此长期停留 Loading preview（内容与渲染资源均 200、无 loadingFailed），种子与上传样例均复现。
findings.impact: 内部资料 DOCX 预览在常见失败形态下表现为“永远加载中”，用户得不到任何解释，直接不满足“失败要说明情况”的要求；应用只能自行在安装副本打补丁。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 传入 workerTimeoutMs，或在组件侧为每次 load 增加有限超时并在超时/Worker 失联时销毁 viewer、走既有错误+下载回退（可选重建 Worker 重试一次）。

diagnosis.trigger: 打开 DOCX 预览且解析 Worker 静默死亡或长时间无响应（第一轮验收及第二轮长会话录像中均出现 Loading preview 后转为渲染失败）。
diagnosis.expected: 在有限时间内渲染正文；若不能，则在超时内显示本地化失败提示并给出可选下载动作，而不是永久停留在加载中。
diagnosis.actual: await viewer.load() 无界且未配置 worker 看门狗，Worker 挂起时 promise 永不 settle，onError 不触发，对话框永久显示 Loading preview。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用在安装副本中为每次 load 增加超时边界，失败后销毁并重建 viewer/Worker 重试一次，随后 B02 通过。
diagnosis.acceptance: 用一个被 stub 为永不返回的解析 Worker 验证：预览必须在约定超时内显示失败提示并提供下载动作，且不得停留在加载中；正常与失败文件切换后不得出现陈旧状态。

findings.title: 注册表图片预览与缩略图缺少 onError，损坏图片只显示破图而无说明
findings.detail: file-preview-content.tsx 的 image 分支与 file-thumbnail.tsx 都直接渲染 ，没有 onError 回退。损坏 PNG 时浏览器显示破图，既无失败文案也无降级占位。应用在安装副本中补了 onError 后才通过 B06。
findings.impact: 与“文件损坏要说明情况、不能把只显示文件名当成预览成功”的要求存在直接落差，在框架原生组件上需要应用兜底。
findings.suggestedChange: 为图片预览与缩略图增加 onError 状态，降级为 FileThumbnail 图标/失败文案并可保留下载动作。

diagnosis.expected: 显示明确的预览失败说明或降级占位，而不是浏览器破图。
diagnosis.actual: 原生 无 onError，损坏图片仅呈现破图，不提供说明。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用在安装副本的图片分支增加 onError 回退后通过 B06。
diagnosis.acceptance: 用损坏 PNG 预览时出现本地化失败提示/占位，且不出现破图或误判为预览成功。

findings.title: 文档称 OOXML 失败会显示错误，但 Worker 静默挂起不触发该回退
findings.detail: 注册表 README 与插件 SKILL 都声明“OOXML 请求或渲染失败会显示错误并提供下载动作”。该契约对拒绝/抛错成立，但对 Worker 静默挂起这类“既不成功也不报错”的失败不成立——组件无超时，onError 也不会被调用。
findings.claimed: OOXML 请求或渲染失败时显示错误和可选下载动作。
findings.observed: 解析 Worker 静默挂起时预览永久停留 Loading preview，既无错误也无下载回退；第一轮 B02 即为此现象。
findings.impact: 读者会据此认为失败一定可见，从而忽略超时/看门狗这一必要加固，导致故障表现为无提示的挂起。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 README/SKILL 中补充：worker 驱动的查看器需要超时或 worker 看门狗，并说明挂起不属于 onError 覆盖的失败形态。

diagnosis.trigger: 阅读“OOXML 失败显示错误”的文档并在私有环境集成 DOCX 预览。
diagnosis.expected: 文档能提示需要为 worker 解析设置超时/看门狗，否则挂起无提示。
diagnosis.actual: 文档只描述抛错型失败，未覆盖静默挂起，实际组件也没有超时。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用在安装副本为 load 增加超时与重试。
diagnosis.acceptance: 文档明确超时/看门狗要求，且提供的默认实现满足该要求。

findings.title: 技能可强化“上传路由由 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 暴露”的正面表述以避免误判
findings.detail: 应用作者在 project-material-files.ts 注释中写下“插件根本没有 HTTP 上传路由”，于是自建上传路由并重复了 multipart/上限/错误码逻辑。插件实际通过 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 暴露 POST /<name>:uploadOne|uploadMany；SKILL 第 118 行虽说明“只有声明的操作才暴露”，但未把“声明即配置路由”作为一句显式结论。
findings.impact: 可能的误读会让应用重复实现上传校验与鉴权，增加维护面并偏离框架契约；本轮应用的重复实现未造成验收失败。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 SKILL 的 API routes 章节前置一句显式说明：上传路由不是缺失，而是需通过 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 声明后由插件挂载，并给一个最小声明示例。

diagnosis.trigger: 实现业务上传端点时查找插件是否提供上传 HTTP 路由。
diagnosis.expected: 明确知道上传路由由 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 声明式挂载。
diagnosis.actual: 作者判断插件没有上传路由并自建路由，重复了校验逻辑。
diagnosis.workaround: 自建应用上传路由，客户端仍复用 ClientFileRepositoryManager 契约。
diagnosis.acceptance: 读者在不查看 dist 的情况下即可从 SKILL 得出上传路由的声明方式。

findings.title: 认证中间件与类型化路由贡献让“匿名/越权拒绝”可直接组合实现
findings.detail: auth.required() 内置 cookie 写来源校验、会话解析与 401 拒绝，并把 auth 注入类型化 context；app-server 的 defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes 让应用以贡献方式挂载，不需要修改插件源码。应用据此实现按 ownerId 的记录级范围，B05 通过。
findings.impact: 私有数据边界可以只依赖稳定的公开原语实现，验证轮次中匿名与同事乙均被拒绝、所有者可读。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持既有中间件与路由契约；如可能，在保护路由的技能参考中补充记录级范围校验的最小示例。

findings.title: 迁移/仓储/事务与 Drive 形成清晰的持久化与存储分层

findings.suggestedChange: 持续在技能中保留“迁移用 query/repository 的取舍”和“事务连接”反例，避免退化到手写 SQL 或事务外写入。

evidence.excerpt:
`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

evidence.excerpt:
## Registry components

The registered Client plugin supplies English and Chinese UI resources. Registry components bind the `@nocobase/app-plugin-file` namespace explicitly; retain the Client registration and `@nocobase/i18n` dependency when installing them. Existing label overrides still take precedence.

Reuse the preinstalled directory when present. For an application without it, materialize `component-ui` from a NocoBase source workspace into the target application:

```bash
pnpm registry materialize --package @nocobase/app-plugin-file --item component-ui --output-root /absolute/path/to/app
```

Materialize copies source only and refuses an existing target directory. Run it from the NocoBase source repository, not from a generated application. For an upgrade, materialize into a separate temporary directory and three-way merge the previous Registry source, new source and application copy; preserve application customizations. The App must provide React/React DOM, lucide-react, react-markdown, remark-gfm and shadcn button/dialog primitives. It adds no route or permissions. A hosted Registry JSON can instead be installed with shadcn add, which reads the item's declared dependencies; npm publication alone supplies no Registry URL.

Default already declares the viewer. For an application installing the source or upgrading an older copy, add the OOXML viewer from the target App directory if missing:

```bash
pnpm add -D --save-exact @silurus/ooxml@0.85.1
```

The viewer belongs in the App's `devDependencies`: Vite compiles this application-owned client source. Registry `dependencies` describes the installation recipe, while a plugin's published runtime Client imports belong in that plugin's `peerDependencies`. Do not move this viewer into server `dependencies` or add it as a plugin peer solely for copied Registry source. Retain the registered file Client plugin for its locale resources. Merge Registry upgrades with App customizations instead of overwriting installed source.

Use a version of `@nocobase/dev-config` whose `createAppViteConfig` excludes `@silurus/ooxml` from dependency prebundling. For an older shared preset or custom Vite configuration, merge this entry into the existing configuration and preserve other exclusions:

```ts
optimizeDeps: {
  exclude: ['@silurus/ooxml'],
},
```

Restart the development server after changing the configuration. This exclusion preserves the viewer's `import.meta.url`-relative WASM paths during development; verify the parser WASM requests in both development and the served production build.

evidence.excerpt:
The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm nocobase db redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Both run inside a transaction by default. `transaction: false` opts out, and a failure then leaves partial work behind with no history record, so take it only when the operation genuinely cannot run in one.
